**Issue #3320 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3320: CI: super run failed on a production candidate
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[super run 42272350992](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42272350992) on #3317, the promotion of `2ec4467caa90` into production, failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [e2e component (chrome)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42272350992/job/128084229055) | failure |
| [fuzz (3/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42272350992/job/128085914745) | failure |
| [e2e (6/8)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42272350992/job/128085914833) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

Night bot: production waits on this run, so it is yours and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item). #3317 promotes `2ec4467caa90`, a commit of `staging` (and so of `main`), so the fix lands on `main` like any other. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). Say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them. Once the fix is on `main`, promote-staging.yml brings it to `staging` within two hours; the next daily run there that passes promotes it, or a `/promote` on the production issue tests staging's newer commit sooner.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/super.yml`._
```

# Draft plan, issue #3320 (super run red on production candidate 2ec4467caa90)

## Found so far
- No access to the job logs: reproducing each failed job locally.
- fuzz (3/4) = seeds 5001..7500 plain and --handicap, Duos seeds 1001..1500 (super.yml `fuzz`).
- e2e (6/8) = specs 06, 07, 10, 12, 16, 17, 30, 42 (same at HEAD; e2e/ unchanged since 2ec4467).
- e2e component (chrome) = `pnpm --dir e2e exec cypress run --component --browser chrome` (all 41 component specs).
- 2ec4467 = #3297 (Activate picker printedOn; I6 invariant change after fuzz-200 failures). Suspect fuzz I6 again.
- Commits since candidate on main: #3268 (phone board, board-layout.cy.tsx rewritten), #3215 practice session in Rust, others.

## Status
- building release jackioh-tools at HEAD (main fbfe940).
- CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/runner/work/JackiOh/JackiOh/target (shared): binary at $CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release/jackioh.
- Background jobs die at 10 min unless timeout set (use timeout 7200000).
- Fuzz plain wave at HEAD: first attempt killed at 2144/2500 (no failure printed before the end-summary). Rerunning all 3 waves.
- Fuzz plain 5001..7500 at HEAD: 2500 passed, 0 failed (704 s). Handicap and Duos waves running.
- Root node_modules were missing: ran `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. WASM built. Component run started.
- Last production: 2b6855b (promote 2026-11-05); 48 commits 2b6855b..2ec4467.

## Failures reproduced at HEAD (fbfe940; engine/cards/ai identical to 2ec4467 but one comment)
1. fuzz --handicap --from 7089 --seeds 1: I2 "extra attack: c77 (stinkyscape-t-drone-corvette, p1's) declared attack number 2 on turn 13" (hard p1, start last-boards). Plain 5001..7500 all pass. Duos pending.
2. component card-faces.cy.tsx: "the engine is not loaded: await loadWasm() before calling face" — `describe("R1017002…")` line 180 calls `rotationPool(true)` at collection time, before support/component.tsx's root `before` loads wasm (#3161 moved faceModel into wasm).
3. component deckbuilder-layout.cy.tsx:368 "at 390x844 with a full deck open, the first row of the pool is on the first screen": 863 > 844.
- Duos 1001..1500: exit 0 (passes). Handicap: only seed 7089 fails.
- ROOT CAUSE fuzz: monitor false positive. Engine trace: c77 Corvette had [Ranged, Flying, Reborn, Windfury] at its first attack; two attacks (Windfury) then died, Reborn'd in the SAME action (autopilot turn), redrew keywords w/o Windfury. `note_drawn_windfury` (invariants.rs ~1930) treats "on field at action end" as conclusive, but the end state holds the later arrival's draw. FIX verified in /tmp/wt-fuzz: `summoned_later(id, &events[index+1..])` helper + 4th param `summoned_again: bool` to note_drawn_windfury, `Some(card) if field && !summoned_again => false`; called at Summoned and Fused branches. Test `r636_a_keyword_drawing_token_reborn_inside_the_action_may_have_attacked_twice_before_it_died` in crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs mod r1869002_i2_a_kill_credit (before the R12 steal test): fails before (same I2 message), passes after. Seed 7089 --handicap passes after.
